coordination.reason: WP801-WP806 and portable-delivery lanes were already actively owned; claim protocol requires review/falsifier work instead of duplicate source ownership

findings.finding: PredictionCandidate carries benchmark_run_id only as an identifier and evaluate_next_observation_prediction does not require or authenticate the canonical WP800 RunDescriptor, even though WP800 provides fixture/provenance/SUT/evidence-ancestry binding.
findings.risk: a prediction can be relabeled to another run id while remaining scoreable, weakening the claimed exact run provenance boundary
findings.smallest_discriminator: require an exact RunDescriptor or bound descriptor digest and reject a candidate whose benchmark_run_id/descriptor binding is changed

findings.finding: the PredictionCandidate is sealed before action_id is supplied; action_id enters only at evaluator execution, so the same prediction may be scored under different actions unless the action schedule is independently predeclared and bound elsewhere
findings.risk: post-hoc action selection or relabeling can change benchmark outcome without changing the prediction identity
findings.smallest_discriminator: bind the forecast action/intervention before scoring and reject evaluation under a different action, or explicitly narrow generation 1 to action-agnostic forecasting and move action-conditioned evaluation to a successor

durable_handoff.active_owner_should_decide: patch generation-1 before bounded acceptance or narrow the accepted claim and route action/run provenance to an explicit successor

next_exact_action: Re-enter PR 463 after its owner responds or updates the head. Verify whether exact WP800 RunDescriptor binding and predeclared action/intervention binding were added or whether the declared generation-1 scope was explicitly narrowed; do not create a competing WP803 source lane.
